draft.subject: Quick help getting Orchard Collective started
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Sorry we missed each other for the getting started call last week — easy to do in a busy stretch.

Whenever you're ready, the simplest first step in Wrenfield is creating your first project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and you can invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything as we go — or just reply here and I'll help by email.

Best,
Priya
